name: CarioApp
tagline: Free Caricature AI — Photo to Fun Portrait
description: CarioApp's Caricature AI turns a clear portrait photo into a stylized caricature. Upload JPG/PNG/WebP/HEIC (up to 10 MB), pick one of 12 styles (Watercolor, 3D Cartoon, Colored Pencil, Pencil Sketch, Pop Art, Oil Painting, Anime, Line Ink, Chibi, Claymation, Vintage Comic, Collectible Figure), optionally add a prompt, and generate. The first caricature is free with no sign-up; free creations may enter public gallery review (original uploads are not shown). Paid options unlock more generations and models.
